mapper.sql: id, org_id, activity_id, name, quantity, unit, assignee_member_id, status, note, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material (org_id, activity_id, name, quantity, unit, assignee_member_id, status, note, created_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{name}, #{quantity}, #{unit}, #{assigneeMemberId}, #{status}, #{note}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM material WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'READY', 'CANCELLED'), id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE material SET name = #{name}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit = #{unit}, assignee_member_id = #{assigneeMemberId}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id}
